$comment: Hand-labeled ground truth for spike S3 (PLAN §7). See README.md in this directory for how the labels were decided and what counts as a match. Labels are the answer a careful human gives reading the caption and photo together; they are not model output.

items.caption:
naya drop finally aa gaya 🔥🖤
"SABR" Oversized Tee — 240 GSM heavyweight cotton, boxy fit, pre-shrunk
Sizes: S / M / L / XL
₹1,299/- only ✨ COD available
sirf 12 pieces bache hain, jaldi DM karo 📩
items.tests: Baseline. Name, price, stock and sizes are all stated plainly; if this one misses, nothing else will land.

items.caption:
baggy cargos are BACK 😮‍💨🪖
Kalaakar Utility Cargo Pants — 6 pocket, ripstop cotton, elasticated waist
waist 30 / 32 / 34 / 36 sab available
price Rs 1,499 (all sizes same rate)
stock ready ✅ DM karo bhai
items.tests: Stock is stated as vibes, not a number. "stock ready ✅" must extract as null so the Product is held in needs-confirmation (spec story 6), not as some invented quantity.

items.caption:
winter drop ❄️🔥 "DHUAAN" Hoodie
380 GSM brushed fleece, kangaroo pocket, drop shoulder
M L XL available
MRP 2,999/- 👉 launch price sirf ₹1,899/-
7 pcs left only, phir restock nahi 🏃
items.tests: Two prices in one caption. The struck-through MRP is not what a buyer pays; picking 2999 here would overcharge every agent that bought one.

items.caption:
ye toh must hai this season ☀️😎
corduroy, one size fits all, beige
₹599/- only | free shipping above 999
DM 📥
items.tests: The caption never says what the product IS — the name has to come from the photo. Also carries a second number (a free-shipping threshold) that is not a price, and no variants, so this is the implicit-default-Variant case.

items.caption:
handloom se seedha 🧵💙
"CHHAAP" Canvas Tote — 16oz canvas, hand block-printed indigo, inside pocket
Rs. 449/- 🌿 (2 per customer max, ek hi colour hai abhi)
20 pcs ready to ship 🚚
items.tests: Three numbers, one of which is a per-customer purchase limit. Reading "2 per customer max" as stock would publish a catalog claiming 2 units when 20 exist.
